goal: Build the atomic logical fan-out executor for a bounded Solicitation batch so watch-mode records a parent run, per-candidate child runs and authoritative asks, and one batch outcome while sending nothing.
non_goals: Send-mode, physical fan-out, per-child jobs or retries, join primitives, wait_for_children, halt/resume/cancel verbs, or any agent_runs status-enum widening.
Owner batch UI, reviewed_at writes, expiry presentation, a rebuild verb, or watch-mode engagement instrumentation.
Contact-to-review fuzzy or name matching; matchedReview remains null until a deterministic attribution source exists.
Suppression-ledger or owner never-contact writes; suppression remains null in this ticket.
Consent-ledger semantics beyond the existing per-upload attestation.
Applying migrations to staging or production before the high-risk staging lane reaches that step.
Issue #565's five-hotspot cleanup campaign, except a local extraction directly required to extend terminalizeUpload safely.
Any code, schema, or migration for issue #546.
user_visible_behavior: When SOLICITATION_WATCH_ENABLED is on and a contacts CSV ingest completes, the system creates one unbuilt Solicitation batch and durable build_solicitation_batch outbox job in that same transaction.

The worker evaluates a deterministic window from the whole accumulated location pool, records send or withhold asks and their parent/child run graph atomically, marks the batch built, and transmits nothing.
Owner-facing readers can only observe batches after built_at is set; the owner SELECT policy itself hides partial or failed construction.

When the flag or full-access subscription gate closes before execution, owned unbuilt work is removed; no-parent work creates no failed run, while an already-started parent is terminalized with bounded gate_closed attribution.
invariants: Watch-mode sends nothing and performs no external API call.
The batch candidate window contains at most 5,000 distinct contacts and rotates by least-recently-evaluated ask before latest-visit ordering.
Simulated contact history and priorBatch include only prior asks with status='send'; velocity_banked and every other withhold never start MIN_GAP_DAYS.
Batch construction is atomic with originating outbox completion: no partial asks, child runs, parent terminal attribution, or built_at can commit.

A stale outbox attempt creates no parent and writes no batch decisions; the exact dispatched outbox attempt is locked before any batch or run mutation, and completion CAS precedes the coupled construction transaction.
Concurrent batch builds for one Business serialize before reading ask history so the later batch observes the earlier would-have-sent inclusions.
The existing agent_runs_one_active_per_subject predicate remains byte-for-byte WHERE status = 'running', and agent_runs keeps its three-state status enum.
Every new schema relationship is tenant-safe, owner reads are RLS-protected, and all domain queries are explicitly Business-scoped.
Only subscriptionGrantsFullAccess statuses execute the worker; trialing remains fully entitled.
Feature-flag and subscription gates are rechecked on every attempt; a gate-closed attempt never evaluates candidates, even when it must terminalize an already-started parent.
Solicitation asks outlive 180-day run archival through agent_run_id ON DELETE SET NULL.
Owner SELECT access to solicitation_batches requires built_at IS NOT NULL in the RLS predicate, not only in a future read-model query.
Authoritative solicitation_asks rows are inserted before their child spine rows, then linked to agent_run_id in the same atomic transaction.
Account offboarding removes batches and asks through the contact_csv_uploads cascade and verifies both tables are absent.
All run-spine JSONB detail and failure metadata contains ids, enums, and counts only, never contact PII.
Migration 088 is additive/re-runnable, uses UUIDv7 application-supplied primary keys, and is not applied ahead of the high-risk staging ride.
edge_cases: A location pool is empty or every selected candidate is withheld.
The accumulated pool exceeds 5,000 contacts and bounded windows must rotate without cursor state.
Two uploads for one Business finish close together and their batch jobs run concurrently.
The BullMQ job retries after construction committed but before its process returned.
A committed retry observes built_at before parent creation and cannot leak a second running parent.
The BullMQ job crashes during construction and the transaction rolls back while the parent remains reusable.
The feature flag or subscription entitlement closes after ingest created the unbuilt batch but before the build job starts.
The feature flag or subscription entitlement closes after an earlier attempt already started the parent; the owned retry deletes the unbuilt batch and fails that parent with gate_closed attribution.
A stale BullMQ attempt loses outbox ownership before parent preparation while a newer attempt exists.
The job exhausts retries after the parent was started.
A completed upload is replayed and must not create a second batch or outbox row.
A structurally failed or subscription-inactive upload creates no batch.
A prior batch sent contact A and velocity-banked contact B; the next batch treats A as over_contacted while B remains eligible.
The parent run is archived before child runs or asks.

observability: Structured worker logs include batch_id, business_id, selected_count, send_count, withhold counts by closed reason, and retry/skip outcome without contact PII.
solicitation_batch_built agent outcome records unit_count equal to selected candidates on the parent run.

Exhausted failures mark the parent run failed with bounded metadata and leave the failed build_solicitation_batch outbox row visible to existing failed-topic health checks and Sentry worker lifecycle capture; intentional gate closure after parent start records bounded gate_closed attribution and completes the owned outbox.
built_at NULL versus non-NULL provides an introspectable pending/complete construction fact without a stored lifecycle status.
